decks.notes: The key concept of this deck is to utilize the Dredge mechanic to fuel the graveyard and quickly fill it with key creatures and spells. By discarding cards and dredging through the deck, the player can trigger effects such as Prized Amalgam and Creeping Chill, which can be returned from the graveyard to the battlefield or directly damage the opponent. The deck also includes additional draw and discard spells to ensure a consistent flow of cards and maximize the graveyard interactions.

This deck focuses on aggressive play with the Orzhov Midrange archetype. It aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy by utilizing cards like Thoughtseize and Dauthi Voidwalker. The deck also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Solitude to maintain board control. It includes powerful artifacts like Sword of Fire and Ice and Kaldra Compleat to enhance the deck's aggression. The deck is also designed to have some resilience with cards like Ephemerate and Undying Evil. The mana base includes a mix of lands that provide colored mana and options for card draw.

The key idea behind this deck is to overwhelm the opponent quickly with fast and efficient burn spells and creatures. The deck focuses on dealing damage as quickly as possible, utilizing direct damage spells like Rift Bolt, Skewer the Critics, Lava Spike, and Lightning Bolt. It also includes efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear, Goblin Guide, and Eidolon of the Great Revel to supplement the burn spells. The deck is designed to be aggressive and put pressure on the opponent early in the game, aiming to win before they have a chance to stabilize.

This deck is built around the concept of controlling the game by utilizing various counterspells and removal spells to hinder your opponent's strategy. It also incorporates card advantage with Snapcaster Mage, allowing you to reuse spells from your graveyard. The deck includes burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Flame of Anor to deal damage to your opponent or remove key threats. Additionally, it includes some land destruction with Molten Collapse and Stern Scolding, allowing you to further disrupt your opponent's plans. Overall, the key concept revolves around maintaining control of the game through counterspells, removal, and card advantage.

This aggro deck focuses on using low-cost creatures and efficient removal spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. By using cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Territorial Kavu to apply early pressure, along with powerful removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Tribal Flames, the goal is to establish a fast clock and close out the game before the opponent has a chance to stabilize. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional flexibility and mana acceleration, allowing for explosive plays in the mid to late game.

This deck revolves around utilizing land ramp and mana acceleration to quickly summon Primeval Titan and search for powerful lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and The One Ring. The synergy between Amulet of Vigor, bounce lands, and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove allows for explosive plays and enables combo potential with Cultivator Colossus. Boseiju, Who Endures protects key spells from counterspells, while Slayers' Stronghold provides utility for Primeval Titan. Overall, this deck aims to assemble a powerful land-based combo engine to overwhelm opponents and secure victory.

This deck focuses on tutoring and sacrificing creatures to generate value and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The goal is to assemble key pieces like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Grist, the Hunger Tide to create a loop of sacrificing and recurring creatures for advantage. Agatha's Soul Cauldron serves as a versatile tool for both offense and defense. With a mix of aggressive creatures like Strangleroot Geist and card advantage engines like Wall of Roots, this deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents in a grindy matchup.

This deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent while also using efficient spells like Lightning Bolt and Counterspell to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. It also includes card draw and selection spells like Consider and Expressive Iteration to help maintain card advantage and find key cards. The deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain tempo throughout the game, disrupting the opponent's plans and quickly closing out the game.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana with Gemstone Caverns and Cascade spells like Violent Outburst to overwhelm the opponent with powerful elemental creatures like Crashing Footfalls and Lórien Revealed. Through cascading into additional spells, the deck aims to maintain board presence and tempo advantage, while also disrupting opponent's strategy with cards like Force of Negation and Subtlety. The deck also includes versatile spells like Dead / Gone and Fire / Ice for removal and control, ensuring the aggro strategy stays effective. With Cascade Crash, the deck aims to control the game by forcing the opponent to react to its aggressive plays.

The deck focuses on using aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Orcish Bowmasters to quickly pressure the opponent. Thoughtseize and Dauthi Voidwalker help disrupt the opponent's game plan, while cards like Fatal Push and Terminate provide removal options. Not Dead After All and Bloodtithe Harvester offer additional ways to drain opponents' life total. The deck also includes some utility lands like Castle Locthwain and takenuma, Abandoned Mire. Overall, the deck aims to apply early pressure and disrupt the opponent's strategy to secure a fast victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing the combination of cards like Violent Outburst and Living End to quickly flood the board with powerful creatures from the graveyard. By cycling through your deck with cards like Street Wraith and Shardless Agent, while also disrupting your opponent's plans with cards like Force of Negation and Subtlety, you are able to set up explosive turns where you cascade into devastating creatures like Waker of Waves and Oliphaunt. Ultimately, the goal is to overwhelm your opponent with an army of creatures and secure victory through sheer force and strategic plays.

This deck aims to ramp up quickly using the Urza lands (Mine, Tower, Power Plant) and assemble the Tron to generate massive amounts of mana. The key strategy is to control the game with powerful spells like Karn, the Great Creator and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon, while also utilizing The One Ring for additional resources. The deck also includes removal spells like Dismember and Oblivion Stone to deal with threats, as well as ways to search for key pieces like Expedition Map and Sylvan Scrying. Ultimately, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats like Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger and Wurmcoil Engine.

The deck revolves around utilizing the Amulet of Vigor to generate powerful combos and ramp into Primeval Titan as quickly as possible. The goal is to assemble the pieces needed to produce multiple land drops per turn, allowing for explosive plays and the ability to quickly search for key lands such as Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and Vesuva. By leveraging these land-based synergies, the deck is able to overwhelm opponents with massive creatures and potent abilities, culminating in a swift victory.

The key concept of this deck is to utilize the combo of Underworld Breach and Hidden Strings to generate mana and repeatedly cast spells from the graveyard. This allows the player to loop through their deck, generating more mana and card advantage. The deck also includes cards like Twiddle, Sylvan Scrying, and Wish to search for combo pieces and fix mana. The One Ring helps generate even more mana and provides protection. Vizier of Tumbling Sands untaps permanents, further fueling the combo. Thassa's Oracle serves as a win condition, allowing the player to deck themselves and win the game.

This deck focuses on quickly playing out powerful spells with cascade to overwhelm the opponent. By casting Crashing Footfalls and Shardless Agent, the deck can create a board presence and generate card advantage. The inclusion of disruption spells like Dead / Gone and Force of Negation helps to control the game and protect your own threats. Overall, the goal is to efficiently use cascade mechanics to put pressure on the opponent and win the game quickly.

The deck focuses on utilizing Amulet of Vigor to quickly ramp into Primeval Titan and combo off with powerful land interactions. By utilizing cards like Dryad of the Ilysian Grove and The One Ring, the deck is able to generate massive amounts of mana and search for key lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle to deal massive amounts of damage. With the ability to tutor for key pieces with cards like Summoner's Pact and Urza's Saga, the deck aims to assemble its combo pieces quickly and overwhelm opponents with its land-based synergies.
